title: Glitch Opera for One Nervous Rectangle
subtitle: A video synthesizer rehearses evidence capture while the rectangle requests a union representative.
learning: Evidence is its own artifact: the running view, optional audio and captured video have distinct custody.

nodes.label: Component
nodes.detail: The Component owns deterministic motion, optional sound and bounded capture.

nodes.label: Video view
nodes.detail: Canvas turns state into a moving image.

nodes.label: Audio Flavor
nodes.detail: A user-authorized oscillator may accompany the picture.

nodes.label: Evidence
nodes.detail: MediaRecorder retains a separate WebM observation when supported.

nodes.label: Acceptance
nodes.detail: Unsupported capture and audio consent fail visibly without breaking animation.
